- [LSCO.8.8] **The five scope properties** (discrete events, bounded
  fact surface, multi-source temporal decisions, outputs-as-
  actions-on-other-systems, policies-change-more-than-code)
  are the lens every future feature proposal gets measured
  against. A proposal that doesn't serve one of them is a
  scope expansion that needs explicit justification.
gap_reason: The tie is DOCUMENTARY, not verifying. The fixture is a deprecated placeholder that compiles one schema and cannot fail. The clause states how feature proposals are judged, which no vector drives. The tie is kept because spec_crossref seeds conformance from the fixture-name convention and would re-add it; the gap is asserted so the clause reads honestly in the coverage report. As for LCON.6.
